info.text:
United's fuel cost jumped about 60%. Guess who's covering the bill.
United Airlines paid $3.90 a gallon in Q3 2026, up from $2.43 a year earlier; its fuel bill hit $4.84 billion.
United says it recovered about 72% of the extra fuel cost through higher revenue and wants that closer to 100%.
Revenue rose 17.4% to $17.9 billion, but United cut its 2026 profit forecast and expects $4.80 a gallon in Q4.
Sources: United Airlines Q3 2026 results (Oct 20, 2026), CNBC, Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
